baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite noun الجحيم at word 2 is followed by the intensive passive سعرت at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun supplies an already severe, ember-rich blaze, while the verb supplies fresh kindling and intensification. Their semantic doubling makes the event a transition from latent furnace to driven combustion, with the actuator left unspoken.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes blazing fire, piled embers, and severe heat as the material already present in الجحيم.
The branch contributes kindling, fuel, and renewed blazing as the state-change imposed by سعرت.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely says that an inferno is burning.
changed_reading.after: An already ember-dense inferno is deliberately brought into a newly intensified burning state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both roots in الجحيم سعرت carry branches in which heat becomes organized violence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun can image battle or death at full blaze, and the verb can image the stirring of war and harm. Read together, the passive does not only heat a place; it escalates a field of violence while withholding the instigator.

activation_trace.role: The branch turns the blaze into battle or death at maximum intensity, supplying the violent field.
The branch contributes the active inflaming of war and harm as the mechanism applied to that field.

changed_reading.before: The passive describes a natural increase of heat.
changed_reading.after: The passive can also describe an offstage escalation of violence into a fully operative conflagration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الجحيم can carry a glowing or staring eye and an anger-flared face, while سعرت can carry burning agitation or madness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots permit the fire to be personified as a furious, wide-eyed presence. Heat becomes affect and gaze: the blaze is not passive scenery but something made agitated enough to confront an observer.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the glowing, widened, sharply staring eye as the blaze's perceptual face.
The branch contributes a face flaring with anger, converting thermal intensity into affective expression.
The branch contributes inner burning, frenzy, affliction, and torment as the condition being excited.

changed_reading.before: The inferno is an impersonal object that emits heat.
changed_reading.after: The inferno can be carried as an exploratory furious presence whose heat looks outward and whose agitation has been activated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive سعرت at word 3 shares its root with the branch for setting a market price.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without context, the pricing branch creates a resistant but grammatical lexical shadow: the blaze has been priced or assigned a cost. The ordinary fire collocation remains dominant, but valuation coexists as an unresolved possibility.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the inferno as the severe object upon which a secondary valuation reading would operate.
The branch supplies market pricing and price-setting as a form-distant passive sense of سعرت.

changed_reading.before: Only the temperature of the inferno changes.
changed_reading.after: A faint second register asks whether the inferno's cost or assessed consequence is being set.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of سعرت includes the sharp beginning of an episode as well as combustion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb can mark not merely more of an existing fire but the acute onset of its operative phase. The ayah then catches the instant at which stored severity becomes an event.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the stored severe heat whose phase can abruptly change.
The branch contributes a sharp onset or acute episode as the temporal profile of the kindling.

changed_reading.before: The line reports a continuing condition of greater heat.
changed_reading.after: The line isolates the threshold at which the inferno enters an acute active phase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding passives fold a radiant body, scatter stars, dislodge mountains, and ignite the seas; the sky is then stripped immediately before the focus blaze is kindled. This revises isolated combustion into the terminal activation of a cosmos whose former containers and stable masses have been released or converted.

activation_trace.role: The severe ember-rich blaze receives the released cosmic material as an inferred terminal furnace.
Kindling and fuel supply the transformation that closes the material sequence.
Folding and wrapping with parts gathered together begins the collapse of a bounded luminous structure.
Scattered rushing and falling converts fixed stars into mobile released matter.
Removal and displacement deprive mountains of their containing stability.
The branch explicitly kindles and agitates fire in the seas, furnishing the nearest material precursor to سعرت.
Removing a cover opens the formerly enclosed scene immediately before the inferno activates.

structural_cues: 81:1-6 and 81:11-12 repeat إذا with a definite subject and passive transformation; 81:6 supplies another feminine passive ignition before سعرت.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collapse, displacement, sea-kindling, uncovering, and the final blaze; I supply the arrow that released structures feed or culminate in that blaze. A live alternative is a noncausal catalogue of independent signs.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained inferno is stoked in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The inferno becomes the operative endpoint of a cascading material reconfiguration of the cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus and 81:13 form an adjacent passive pair: the inferno is intensified and the covered garden is driven near. Opposed destinations are not merely said to exist; both are made operationally present, one by activation and one by approach.

activation_trace.role: The branch gives one destination the material form of severe exposed heat.
Fresh kindling makes that destination presently operative rather than merely stored.
The covered garden supplies the contrasting sheltered destination.
Its rush into nearness supplies the matching activation-by-proximity on the other side of the pair.

structural_cues: 81:12 and 81:13 are adjacent وإذا clauses with feminine passive verbs, followed by the resolving knowledge clause in 81:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two neighboring passive preparations; I infer that their symmetry stages alternatives for encounter. They may instead remain separate items in the catalogue without constituting a binary pair.

changed_reading.before: The inferno's kindling is one disaster among many.
changed_reading.after: Its kindling is one half of a paired presentation in which opposed outcomes are brought into immediate encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning, charge, killing, opened writing, disclosed knowledge, and what the self has made present form an evidentiary chain around the focus. The violent blaze is therefore revised from uncontrolled harm into a consequence switched on after the case and its record become present.

activation_trace.role: Battle or death at full blaze supplies the punitive violence whose status is being revised.
Inflaming harm supplies the activation of consequence rather than a merely ambient fire.
Reciprocal questioning introduces an interrogative and testimonial procedure.
Guilt or offense supplies the explicit issue to be adjudicated.
Taking life supplies the concrete wrong rather than an abstract accusation.
Writing or an opened book supplies the inspectable record.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the moment when the record becomes undeniable knowledge.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness turn prior acts into evidence brought before the self.

structural_cues: The branchless و ء د occurrence at 81:8 structurally identifies the questioned victim; no mapped root or branch is assigned to it.
The sequence moves from question and offense to opened records, kindled consequence, and self-recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a victim, questioning, offense, killing, records, disclosure, and presence; I infer a procedural arrow from evidence to activated consequence. The sequence may instead juxtapose disclosure and punishment without specifying their causal order.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is violence being intensified for its own sake.
changed_reading.after: The blaze is activated as an adjudicative consequence once victim, charge, record, and self-produced evidence are present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky-cover is removed immediately before the focus; later there is direct sight at a manifest horizon and no withholding of the hidden. These visibility cues strengthen the eye branch of الجحيم: the inferno is uncovered as a confronting presence, and its glare can be carried as a gaze that meets the viewer.

activation_trace.role: The glowing or staring eye gives the uncovered blaze a confrontational visual form.
Removing the cover supplies the immediate transition from concealment to exposure.
Vision by eye and insight establishes actual seeing rather than speculative imagery.
Manifest appearance supplies the clarity in which the fiery presence can confront the observer.
Concealment from eyes supplies the state that the surrounding revelation reverses.
Withholding supplies the explicitly negated barrier to disclosure.

structural_cues: The focus stands directly after the sky is stripped, while 81:23-24 return to sight, manifestation, hiddenness, and non-withholding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering and a later visibility lexicon; I infer that the focus blaze participates in that disclosure and that its eye image looks back. The live alternative is one-way visibility: the observer sees the fire, but no reciprocal gaze is implied.

changed_reading.before: The fire becomes hotter behind the catalogue of cosmic events.
changed_reading.after: The stripped scene reveals a glaring presence that confronts the knower rather than remaining hidden scenery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Movement pervades the context: mountains are displaced, groups are driven to a destination, and celestial runners flow into disappearance. This activates the ranging and rapid-running branch of سعرت, allowing the kindled inferno to behave as a mobile firefront that spreads, gathers, and withdraws rather than as a fixed pit.

activation_trace.role: The severe blaze supplies the combustion that the kinetic model sets in motion.
Ranging movement, scattering in every direction, and rapid running supply the firefront's mobility.
Going and flowing turn even mountains into participants in the context's motion field.
Driving a gathered group toward a destination supplies directed collective motion.
Flowing and coursing supply a later celestial analogue for a mobile burning front.
Celestial disappearance into hiding supplies intermittent withdrawal within that movement.

structural_cues: The early transformed bodies move or are driven, and 81:15-16 later compress running and hiding into a single celestial image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple kinds of directed and celestial motion plus a ranging branch in the focus verb; I infer that combustion itself spreads as a moving front. The standard alternative keeps movement in the context and treats الجحيم as stationary.

changed_reading.before: The inferno is a stationary furnace whose intensity rises.
changed_reading.after: The inferno can be explored as an activated, ranging front of combustion moving through the dislocated scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus passive suppresses its agent. The later chain of utterance, sending, concentrated strength, empowerment, obedience, and trust supplies a model of authorized transmission; on that model, the kindling is an executed command within an ordered administration, not spontaneous combustion.

activation_trace.role: The passive kindling supplies an executed action while leaving its actuator grammatically unexpressed.
Spoken utterance supplies the command-bearing content of the transmission model.
Sending and dispatch supply movement of an instruction through an agent.
Concentrated strength like strands of a rope supplies capacity to carry out the instruction.
Empowerment and established capability supply delegated authority.
Obedient compliance supplies reliable execution within the chain.
Security and trust supply confidence that the transmitted action is not corrupted.

structural_cues: 81:19-21 build a compact chain from القول through messenger status and power to obedience and trustworthiness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an agentive transmission hierarchy and the focus supplies an agentless passive; I infer that the hierarchy can model how the passive event is executed. The text may only authenticate revelation, without identifying any executor of the fire.

changed_reading.before: The unexpressed agent makes the kindling feel spontaneous or unexplained.
changed_reading.after: The passive can signal an authorized act whose executor is backgrounded because the command structure, not the individual actuator, matters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root permits burning agitation and madness, but the later discourse explicitly denies covered reason in the companion and rejects the utterance of a rebellious, expelled source. The frenzy reading is therefore retained but relocated: the ordeal and its fire are made madly agitated; the messenger and message are not.

activation_trace.role: The anger-flared face gives the ordeal an affective surface.
Burning agitation, madness, and torment supply the frenzy that must be assigned somewhere in the scene.
Covering of reason by madness names the condition explicitly negated of the companion.
The rebellious satan supplies the second rejected candidate for disordered speech.
Cursing and expulsion remove that rebellious source from the authorized discourse.

structural_cues: The explicit negations in 81:22 and 81:25 bracket the sight claim and sharply police where disorder may and may not be located.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch of frenzy and later denials of mad or satanic provenance; I infer a rhetorical relocation of agitation from speaker to eschatological scene. The alternative is that the two lexical fields are unrelated despite their proximity in one surah.

changed_reading.before: The personified frenzy of the blaze risks bleeding into the later accusation of a mad speaker.
changed_reading.after: The context contains that image: frenzy belongs to the activated blaze and torment, while madness and satanic provenance are denied of the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weak focus-only price shadow gains a coherent valuation network from a share or lot, allocation, appraisal and pricing, and even the non-dominant mapped branch of transactional increase. The inferno can thus be carried, without replacing kindling, as a consequence whose cost is allocated, assessed, and intensified.

activation_trace.role: The severe inferno supplies the costly consequence being secondarily assessed.
Market price and price-setting supply the central valuation pivot inside the focus verb.
A share or allotted portion lets consequence be imagined as something apportioned.
Separating and allocating a share strengthens the apportionment mechanism.
Value, appraisal, and pricing directly reactivate the market-price branch of سعرت.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes transactional increase, supplying the exploratory sense of an escalating cost.

structural_cues: 81:8-14 assembles account and consequence, while 81:28-29 frames straight direction and will under رب العالمين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies price-setting, shares, allocation, appraisal, and a non-dominant transaction-increase branch; I infer that these can reprofile the focus passive as assessed consequence. The dominant alternatives are literal kindling, استقامة rather than appraisal in 81:28, and lordship rather than transaction in 81:29.

changed_reading.before: The price sense is an isolated lexical echo with no mechanism.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a contained moral-economic reading in which the inferno is the allocated and escalating cost of what has been brought to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreating lights, celestial hiding, thin darkness at either edge of night, first morning, and dawn opening like breath form a hide-and-emerge cycle. They sharpen the acute-onset branch of سعرت: the blaze is a threshold event, an abrupt emergence from latency rather than a monotone increase.

activation_trace.role: The stored blaze supplies the latent state that can cross a threshold.
Sharp onset and first intensity supply the focus event's threshold profile.
Lights that hide and return supply reversible latency.
Celestial disappearance into a hiding place deepens the concealed phase.
Thin darkness at either boundary of night supplies an ambiguous transition rather than a fixed state.
The first of day supplies the emergence phase of the cycle.
The opening of dawn like a breath gives emergence a gradual release that culminates after concealment.

structural_cues: 81:15-18 places paired hiding and running lights beside the double-edged night and the breathing morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later cycle of concealment and emergence; I use it retrospectively to calibrate سعرت as an onset within that cycle. The oath images may instead authenticate the message without describing the temporal mechanics of the focus event.

changed_reading.before: Acute onset is merely a dictionary nuance of the focus root.
changed_reading.after: The onset becomes one threshold in a surah-wide rhythm where stored realities hide, cross an edge, and become manifest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the peripheral sunlit-dust branch of س ع ر rather than the verb's ordinary combustion branch. It remains anchored in سعرت and in the ember-rich الجحيم, while sun, scattering, uncovering, and sight make particulate visibility coherent. Downstream prose should render it only as an optical afterimage or 'as if' layer, never as the lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سعرت at word 3 can evoke motes visible in sunlight, while الجحيم at word 2 supplies glowing ember material.

activation_trace.role: Sunlit dust motes supply the peripheral optical image of suspended luminous particles.
Piled embers and intense glow convert neutral motes into a particulate blaze.
The sun supplies the beam-source presupposed by the motes image even as it is folded away.
Scattered rushing and falling supply particulate dispersion.
Removal of the cover supplies the reveal that makes the dispersed glow visible.
Actual sight supplies the observer needed for the optical effect.

changed_reading.before: A compact body of fire is stoked.
changed_reading.after: As a contained optical layer, the stripped scene fills with scattered ember-like particles that suddenly register as the blaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it uses the dug-oven sense of س ع ر and the smith's-kiln sense of ك و ر. It remains anchored in the focus verb's oven branch, the literal blaze noun, the kindled seas, and the skinning of the sky. It should be carried as a material analogy for the sequence, not as a claim that الجحيم lexically means the universe or that سعرت means an oven was dug.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of سعرت at word 3 includes a dug baking oven, and الجحيم at word 2 supplies its severe fire.

activation_trace.role: The oven-like pit dug for baking supplies the unusual container model for the blaze.
Severe heat and piled embers supply the contents of that oven model.
A smith's kiln built from clay supplies a second furnace-shaped material analogy at the sequence's opening.
Kindling the seas lets the former contents of the world function as distributed oven fuel.
Skinning a covering supplies the image of an oven or furnace whose roof has been stripped away.

changed_reading.before: The inferno is one bounded object inside the transformed world.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, the world itself becomes an unroofed kiln whose waters are kindled and whose concentrated heat is named at the focus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from fire into physiology through the inner-burning and breath branches. It remains anchored in the anger-flared الجحيم and the bodily fever, hunger, thirst, frenzy, and torment carried by س ع ر, while the context names living selves and a breathing dawn. Render it as personification of the cosmos or ordeal, explicitly qualified, not as a literal organism or a replacement for fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الجحيم at word 2 can flare like an angry face, and سعرت at word 3 can denote a body's burning agitation and affliction.

activation_trace.role: A face flaring from inner anger supplies the bodily surface of the personification.
Interior heat, hunger, thirst, frenzy, affliction, and torment supply a fever-like physiology.
The life-bearing self supplies the explicit organismal register in the surrounding sequence.
Breath issuing from an interior supplies the respiration mechanism for the personified scene.
First morning supplies the moment at which the larger scene appears to inhale and open.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is external heat acting on bodies.
changed_reading.after: As a contained personification, the ordeal becomes a fevered body whose angry face is heated from within and whose world later releases a breath.

strongest_changes: The isolated furnace became the endpoint of a cascading conversion of folded, scattered, displaced, kindled, and uncovered cosmic materials.
The adjacent passive pair in 81:12-13 made the blaze and garden co-present alternatives rather than static destinations.
Question, offense, killing, record, disclosure, and presence revised intensified violence into an adjudicative consequence.
The passive could also be read through authorized execution, while the later denial of madness relocated frenzy from messenger to ordeal.
A direct pricing bridge from ق و م preserved the exploratory reading of the blaze as an allocated and escalating cost.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported mutually live material, martial, visual, affective, temporal, and economic mechanisms. Context did not collapse them: it strengthened literal kindling, made it judicial and administratively executed, exposed it as a confronting presence, and unexpectedly gave the weak price branch a real valuation network.
remaining_uncertainties: The context never states that cosmic disassembly materially fuels the inferno; that causal arrow remains abductive.
The 81:12-13 symmetry may stage paired outcomes, or it may simply continue the catalogue of independent transformations.
Authorized transmission clearly authenticates the message, but its use as a model for the suppressed agent of سعرت is inferential.
Pricing, particulate optics, the unroofed oven, and fevered physiology depend on peripheral branches and must remain qualified overlays rather than translations.
